definitions.explanation: A yellow citrus fruit with a sour taste, used in cooking, drinks, and flavoring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧レモン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put lemon in my tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧レモン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦さっぱりして→さっぱりする：26802_sapparisuru⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Squeezing lemon over fried food makes it taste refreshing and delicious.

notes:
レモン is a loanword from English "lemon," referring to both the fruit and the flavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レモン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧: to squeeze a lemon
- レモン{汁|じる}: lemon juice
- レモンティー: lemon tea
- レモンサワー: lemon sour (a hugely popular Japanese highball-style drink)
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{物|もの}→揚げ物：04975_agemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧レモン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to squeeze lemon over fried food

COMPOUNDS:
- レモン⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: lemon flavor
- レモン⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧: lemon yellow
- ⟦{国産|こくさん}→国産：12017_kokusan⟧レモン: domestically grown lemon

CULTURAL NOTE:
Squeezing lemon over shared ⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧ (fried chicken) without asking first is a famously controversial social topic in Japan — some people love it and some hate it. レモンサワー has become one of the most popular alcoholic drinks in Japan.
